subject: Kickoff: Anthea — MQM translation quality evaluation
body:
Hi Bao, team,

Kicking off Anthea. It's a translation quality evaluation tool that presents source and translated text side by side in a natural, flowing layout rather than the artificial tabulated view raters hate, with configurable segment sizes. It's built for Multidimensional Quality Metrics and ships exemplary MQM templates.

Why now: our current rater workflow produces MQM scores nobody trusts because segmentation is inconsistent between rater cohorts. Anthea makes segmentation a template decision instead of a per-rater habit.

Milestones: internal deployment (it's static files served from a web server, so this should be days not weeks) by late February, template selection and a rater calibration round in March, readout the week of April 13.

Anders
